problem: Compact decoding can share a coefficient list between separate target components. The earlier in-place rename applied a permutation repeatedly to shared storage, causing checker rejections.
fix: Each renamed component receives a freshly constructed coefficient vector; frozen earlier tools and proof artifacts are unchanged.
trust_note: No accepted proof depended on producer correctness: every accepted target was independently kernel checked. This defect lost candidate proofs; it did not create unverified bound claims.
